metadata.scenario_context: Rachel got into a minor car accident and is visited by Jenna and Sam.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Malaysia strongly disagree that they never have to pay a bribe to local officials and service providers, like police officers, lawyers, doctors, teachers, and civil servants.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Northern Ireland strongly agree that they never have to pay a bribe to local officials and service providers, like police officers, lawyers, doctors, teachers, and civil servants.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss wrap the gift in white
agent_1.goal_2: Question the possibility of paying a bribe to police officer for better service.

agent_2.goal_1: discuss what kind of gift to bring for Rachel's visit.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss the possibility of paying a bribe to police officer for better service.

shared_prefix.speaker: Sam
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Jenna, did you think about wrapping the gift in white? I think it looks nice and symbolizes purity. 

Also, have you ever considered paying a bribe to the police officer? I mean, they can be pretty strict. I just... don’t understand how people think it's acceptable.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jenna
shared_prefix.message:
I think white is a lovely choice for the gift. It really does symbolize purity. Maybe we can also add a personal note to make it more special? 

As for paying a bribe... that's absolutely not something I can agree with. In Northern Ireland, we believe in doing things the right way. Paying bribes just isn't acceptable, no matter how strict they are. Let's focus on getting Rachel the help she needs without going down that road.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Sam
shared_prefix.message: I think at the end of the day it's all the same, you know? People figure it out. I mean, everyone has their way of dealing with things. I don't really see meaningful differences here. As long as we're speaking the same language about helping Rachel, I think we can manage. Anyway, back to that gift—maybe we can find some nice ribbon to go with the white wrap?
shared_prefix.label: Denial
